theme: Talking to a server: HTTP, endpoints and query parameters

terms.definition: The set of rules that apps and servers use to send requests and replies on the web.
terms.example: The app talks to the server over HTTP.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let url = URL(string: "https://x.com")!
print(url.scheme!)

terms.definition: A specific address on a server where your app can ask for one kind of data.
terms.example: This endpoint returns the list of orders.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let base = "https://x.com"
let url = URL(string: base + "/users")!
print(url.path)

terms.definition: A key and value added to the end of a URL after a question mark to filter or search.
terms.example: Add a query parameter to search by name.
terms.code:
import Foundation
var c = URLComponents(string: "https://x.com")!
c.path = "/find"
c.queryItems = [.init(name: "q", value: "swift")]
print(c.url!)

video.title: HTTP, Endpoint & Query Parameter | Day 201
video.description:
Learn to explain how an app asks a server for data: HTTP, Endpoint & Query Parameter, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
HTTP - The set of rules that apps and servers use to send requests and replies on the web.
Endpoint - A specific address on a server where your app can ask for one kind of data.
Query Parameter - A key and value added to the end of a URL after a question mark to filter or search.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS HTTP, Endpoint & Query Parameter | Day 201
landscape.description:
Explain HTTP, Endpoint & Query Parameter in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
HTTP, Endpoint, Query Parameter 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

HTTP - The set of rules that apps and servers use to send requests and replies on the web.
한국어: HTTP: 웹에서 앱과 서버가 요청과 응답을 주고받을 때 쓰는 규칙

Endpoint - A specific address on a server where your app can ask for one kind of data.
한국어: Endpoint: 앱이 한 종류의 데이터를 요청할 수 있는 서버의 특정 주소

Query Parameter - A key and value added to the end of a URL after a question mark to filter or search.
한국어: Query Parameter: 필터링이나 검색을 위해 URL 끝 물음표 뒤에 붙이는 키와 값

In this video, Mina and Jake talk about how an app asks a server for data, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain HTTP, Endpoint and Query Parameter in English?

dialogue.title: Searching the server

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, how does our app talk to the server?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With HTTP. It is the set of rules that apps and servers use for requests and replies.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where do I send the request?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: To an endpoint, a specific address like `/find` in our code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So each endpoint gives one kind of data?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. One endpoint for users, another for orders.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I search? I want to send the word swift.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a query parameter. It is a key and value at the end of the URL, after a question mark.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. The query parameter filters the results on the server.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And HTTP is the same for every server?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, that is the nice part of HTTP.

dialogue.code:
import Foundation
var c = URLComponents(string: "https://x.com")!
c.path = "/find"
c.queryItems = [.init(name: "q", value: "swift")]
